At the engagement banquet of my childhood friend, someone brought up the groom’s ex-girlfriend.
“I heard she was a star, and they were together for two or three years.”

141304.synopsis:
Banished to a distant southern island after falling out of favor with the Crown Prince, the magician Lowie found himself relishing his newfound freedom—at least for a little while. But soon, loneliness and melancholy began to creep in. Unable to bear it any longer, Lowie decided to purchase a s*ave.
Only to discover… his s*ave used to be a holy knight?
“More than that, I’m curious about something else.”
 “Pardon?”
 “Have you really killed a demon before?”
Lowie’s eyes sparkled with childlike curiosity.
“…So let me get this straight. You were the Commander of the Elysion Order, the Holy Knights, and the sacred sword originally belonged to you—but you had no money, so the sword was sold… and then you were sold too?”
 “That’s… correct.”
At such a pitiful summary of his life, Ban bowed his head in shame.
“And you actually didn’t even like being a Commander, so you decided to just live the rest of your life as my s*ave?”
 “That’s not quite what I—”
He hadn’t said that much, had he? He’d merely confessed that after fulfilling his divine mission, he’d been left with a hollow emptiness inside. Yet somehow, Lowie had interpreted that in that way. Ban’s expression grew subtly conflicted.
“But so what? The Elysion Order’s already fallen apart, hasn’t it? What difference does God make anymore?”
 “Fallen—well, it’s not quite fallen…”
 “They said it’s a tourist site now.”
Lowie clearly remembered what the auctioneer had said during the sale.
“Told me to go visit it sometime, since it’s open for sightseeing.”
 “……”
 “Anyway, it’s not that big of a deal. Gods or whatever—they’re all the same. From now on, you’re mine, and it’s only natural for a master to take care of what belongs to them. If anything dangerous happens, call for me.”
I’ll protect you.
With his chin lifted confidently, Lowie declared it as though it were the most obvious thing in the world.

Lu Qing transmigrated and became a minor scholar in Manglong Village. At a time when he was starving on wild vegetables and had nothing but an empty house, the local authorities suddenly forced a beautiful wife onto him.
While everyone believed Lu Qing had picked up a worthless burden and would surely end up in prison next year, no one expected what came next. Lu Qing’s life flourished—he built houses, started factories, became famous far and wide, and even caught the attention of the imperial court…

154616.synopsis:
Du Heng transmigrated into a cripple, a man whom a fierce young master took home as a husband.
The young master (fierce): “Since your legs aren’t working right, don’t think about running off. Behave as my husband, and I’ll make sure you’re never hungry.”
Du Heng: …
A grown man reduced to living off someone else? Impossible! Even if he’d transmigrated, he would never submit!
—The next day, the young master returned from the fields to find the dirty clothes he had changed out of the night before hanging out to dry in the yard, and three perfectly cooked dishes on the table.
Du Heng: As long as I cooked it myself, it doesn’t count as living off anyone.
—That night, Du Heng was about to blow out the lamp and sleep, when the young master walked in, stripping off clothes as he climbed into bed.
Young master: “Let’s take care of things while there’s free time. Lie still, I’ll handle it.”
Du Heng clenched the corner of his blanket with gritted teeth. He hadn’t even had a romantic encounter before—this was only the third day they’d met! No way would he yield!
—The following year, the little one ran around the yard. Du Heng put down his book with a sigh, picked up the child, and went to call his husband home for dinner.
 Brief summary: If I cook it myself, it’s not freeloading.

Zedekiah—the son of the man who seized the regime through a coup, and a powerholder ranking among the very few at the top, even within District 1 where the supreme ruling class resides.
